Card credits

Chase Sapphire Reserve credits and when they expire

Every statement credit on the Chase Sapphire Reserve (annual fee $795), what it is worth, and when it resets. Last verified October 2, 2026.

CreditAmountResets
Annual travel credit$300 per yearEvery year, on your card anniversary
The Edit hotel credit$500 per yearEvery calendar year (Dec 31)
Exclusive Tables dining credit$150 every six monthsTwice a year: Jun 30 and Dec 31
StubHub credit$150 every six monthsTwice a year: Jun 30 and Dec 31
Lyft credit$10 per monthEvery month (last day of the month)
Peloton credit$10 per monthEvery month (last day of the month)
Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS credit$120 per four yearsOnce every four years

If you used every recurring credit above in a full year, that adds up to about $1,640 against the $795 annual fee. Most people use only some of them, which is why tracking matters.

Details come from the issuer's public terms and reputable reviews, and issuers change credits often. Always confirm the current terms with your issuer before relying on a credit. PerkaBoo is not affiliated with any card issuer or bank.
